Name: Quartermaster_Wilds_Dialogue
$Comment: The Emerald Wilds quartermaster, and the character the ledger quest is handed in to.
Start.First is tried in the order written and the first beat whose When conditions pass wins,
so greet_active greets a player mid-ledger with the hand-in line and everyone else falls
through to Fallback. Which greeting shows is derived from the quest's own state rather than
from anything remembered, so resetting the quest also resets the conversation instead of
MarkTalked on the trade option is the only thing that credits a talk step or a met-the-giver
achievement here; nothing counts a character as spoken to on its own.
A set of givers that share a skeleton can be written once as a file marked Abstract and inherited
by 'Parent': '<that id>', which merges node by node so a child restates only the beats it changes.
